Commentary.Commentary: We are back for the chase! The players have made their way out to the middle. Litton Das and Munim Shahriar will open the batting for Bangladesh. Wellington Masakadza will begin with the ball. Here we go...
... THE RUN CHASE ...

Well for Bangladesh, it was only one man who did most of the damage. Mosaddek Hossain! He grabbed 5 wickets in his spell of 4 overs and demolished Zimbabwe's batting line-up. He had Zimbabwe reeling at 31 for 5 as he bowled fours on the trot! Post his spell, the other bowlers found it difficult to break the stand between Sikandar Raza and Ryan Burl and let Zimbabwe get away with over 100 runs. They fought back well towards the end and restricted them to a total of 135! It's been an exceptional bowling performance from the visitors and they do have an opportunity here to keep the series alive. Can they do so? We will find out soon. Stay tuned for the second essay.

At the toss, Craig Ervine mentioned that they want to bat first and put a strong total once again. But things did not go as planned. They lost two wickets in the very first over and were put under the pump straightaway. The wickets continued to tumble and they lost half their side within the first seven overs. Post that Mr. Consistent, Sikandar Raza, and Ryan Burl put on a partnership of 80 runs and helped Zimbabwe cross the 100-run mark. Sikandar Raza notched up yet another half-ton in this innings. In the end, Zimbabwe put on a fighting total and have given their bowlers something to bowl at.

Around 24 hours back Zimbabwe put on a total of over 200 on this same wicket. But the story has completely changed in this game. They struggled to get going and as a result, have managed to score only 135. Nevertheless, it's been a good recovery from them. At one stage a total of 100 was looking far-fetched but they have done reasonably well. Bangladesh though will be quite pleased with their performance. They might fancy their chances of leveling the series here.

Two to end the innings! This was a close call by the third umpire. Shoriful Islam serves a low full toss in line with the stumps and Luke Jongwe knocks this towards long on. They come back for the second and the throw is good at the keeper's end. Nurul Hasan whips the bails off and at first glance, this looks to be out. The third umpire takes his time on this decision and there is a difference of just one frame. In the end, the benefit of the doubt goes to the batter and Zimbabwe have one more run in their kitty. They end the innings at 135/8.
SIX! KABOOM! Top shot! A full toss, outside off. Luke Jongwe opens the face of the bat and smashes it over deep point for a biggie!
WIDE! Shoriful Islam serves a yorker wide outside off. This is beyond the tram line and is an easy call for the umpire.
Richard Ngarava is the new man in.

OUT! RUN OUT! What a last over this is from Shoriful Islam! Wellington Masakadza comes down the wicket to a length ball outside off. He swings his bat and misses. Luke Jongwe calls for a single and bumps into his partner. Nurul Hasan throws the ball towards the bowler who grabs the ball and throws it directly at the non-striker's end. Wellington Masakadza has to depart and Zimbabwe are eight down now!
Full once again and wide outside off, Luke Jongwe reaches for it and thumps it towards deep cover for a single.
This is served on a good length and wide outside off, Luke Jongwe looks to play this leg side and misses. This has been adjudged wide.
Full delivery on off, Wellington Masakadza knocks this towards long on for a single.
Swing and a miss! This is on a good length and outside off, Wellington Masakadza can not get bat to it.
Wide of off, very full again. Wellington Masakadza squeezes it out towards third man for a single.
Yorker, around off. Wellington Masakadza does well to dig this one out.
FOUR! Edgy runs! A fuller ball, around off. Wellington Masakadza swings his bat hard at it but the ball goes off the inside edge and away from the diving keeper towards fine leg for a boundary.
WIDE! This one is outside off and full, once again really close to the tram line. Wellington Masakadza misses and is called wide once again by the umpire.
This is full and wide outside off, Luke Jongwe taps this towards short third man and takes a single.

OUT! CAUGHT! Was the misfield planned? Sikandar Raza has departed the very next delivery! Mustafizur Rahman serves this full outside off, Sikandar Raza looks to heave this towards the offside but does not get under this one. Ends up skying this as it falls straight into the hands of the cover fielder. Munim Shahriar makes no mistake grabbing hold of this one. Bangladesh have their breakthrough and the danger man departs!
Commentary.Howout: c Munim Shahriar b Mustafizur Rahman

Commentary.Commentary: This is on a length and pitching on middle and off, Sikandar Raza clips this towards square leg, and a misfield allows him to take a couple of runs and keep strike.
WIDE! Wide yorker angled away from the batter. The umpire calls this wide and the bowler is really unhappy.
Width on offer now, fullish in length. Sikandar Raza reaches out to it and manages to get some bat on that. It goes towards third man and they take a single.
A low full toss, around middle. Luke Jongwe drags it with the inner half of his bat towards square leg for a single.
Luke Jongwe walks out to the middle.

OUT! KNOCKED HIM OVER! The partnership has finally been broken! A length ball, tailing in a tad, around off. Ryan Burl looks to hoick this over mid-wicket but he misses it and the ball goes on to hit the off pole. A good knock from Ryan Burl comes to an end!
Fuller ball, around middle. Ryan Burl drills it down to long on for a brace. Good running!
On a length now, around middle and leg. Ryan Burl shuffles across and tries to scoop this away but he fails to get any bat on it.
FOUR! Crunched! Fuller ball, outside off. Ryan Burl makes room and drives it powerfully through cover for a cracking boundary. Good start to the over for Zimbabwe!
SIX! That's a mighty blow from Sikandar Raza! Takes the pace off again, tad full, and outside off. Sikandar Raza gets low and smashes this over deep mid-wicket for a biggie. 100 up for Zimbabwe!
Shorter and wide of off. Ryan Burl slaps it towards long off. The ball goes once bounce to the fielder there. Only a single!
Slightly shorter, slower again, outside off. Sikandar Raza dabs it towards third nan for a single.

Miscommunication again! But no harm done! Slower ball, full and around off. Sikandar Raza drives it towards cover. Ryan Burl leaves his crease for a single. A loud shout of 'No' from Sikandar Raza, sends Ryan Burl back in time. Had there been a direct hit at the bowler's end he would have been in trouble. But the throw was to the bowler.
Overpitched again, around middle. Ryan Burl flicks it towards mid-wicket. Only a single this time.
Fuller ball, around middle. Ryan Burl drives it away from long on and takes two quick runs. Good aggressive running from these two!
Hasan Mahmud goes full on the pads, Ryan Burl clips this towards wide long on and has taken the first run quickly. Refuses the second and he keeps strike for the next over.
On a good length and delivered on middle and leg. Ryan Burl clips this towards deep square leg for a brace.
Goes closer to the stumps and serves this full, Sikandar Raza knocks this towards long on for a single.
Executes the wide delivery perfectly this time. This is full and just inside the wide line. Sikandar Raza looks to guide this and misses.
WIDE! Hasan Mahmud tries to keep this away from Sikandar Raza as he serves this fll outside off. The umpire calls this one wide.
Full once again and angling away from the left-hander. Ryan Burl gets a thick outside edge towards backward point for a single.
Hasan Mahmud goes full and outside off, Sikandar Raza hit this in the air and slices it wide of long off for a single.

Pitches it up again, around middle. Sikandar Raza knocks it down to long on for a single. Fifty for Sikandar Raza! Back-to-back half-centuries for him. What a crucial knock this has been. He will want to stick around till the end and take his side to a fighting total.
Fuller one, around middle. Sikandar Raza tucks it in the vacant mid-wicket region for a brace. Good running!
On a length, around middle. Sikandar Raza blocks it out solidly.

FOUR! Back-to-back boundaries! Good shot by Raza! Slightly shorter now, around off. Sikandar Raza backs away and upper cuts it over short third man for another boundary. That brings up the 50-run stand between these two!
FOUR! Easy pickings! Shorter one, down the leg side. Sikandar Raza pulls it fine and towards fine leg for a boundary.

A fuller delivery, outside off. Ryan Burl dances towards the off side, he wanted to play the scoop shot over short fine leg. But he checks his shot at the end and plays it through his legs. The ball hits his pads and rolls away towards the keeper. A single taken!
This one is short as well, and outside off, Ryan Burl gets the toe end of his bat as he tries to pull this. Gets a single to long on in the process.
A fraction short and outside off, Ryan Burl is down the wicket but mistimes his shot back towards the bowler.
This is really full and angled into the pads, Sikandar Raza clips this towards deep square leg for a single.
This is a fraction full and angling into the batter. Ryan Burl clips this towards deep mid-wicket and looks for a couple. Has to settle for just a single though.

FOUR! Thick outside edge for a boundary! Shoriful Islam bowls this on a good length and outside off stump, Ryan Burl is down the wicket to heave this into the offside. Gets an edge that flies towards the third man fence for a much-needed boundary!
Shoriful Islam begins with a good-length delivery outside off, Sikandar Raza guides this to third man for a single.
Slower through the air, full and outside off. Ryan Burl lunges forward and tries to block this but he gets beaten on the outside edge as the ball spins away.
FOUR! Perfectly executed! Another fuller one, around middle. Ryan Burl gets low and reverse-sweeps this over point for a boundary.
Tosses it up, pitches it up, around off. Ryan Burl leans forward and drives it towards the fielder at cover.
Quick single! Fuller now, around middle. Sikandar Raza taps it towards mid-wicket and scampers across to the other end. There is a throw at the keeper's end but Ryan Burl is well in.

SIX! BANG! A gift to Sikandar Raza and he is not going to miss out on these! Afif Hossain goes 'round the wicket, serves a full toss, around middle. Sikandar Raza gets low and dispatches this one high over deep square leg for a biggie!
Afif Hossain begins with a fuller ball, around middle and off. Ryan Burl leans forward and drives it towards long off for a single.
Afif Hossain comes into the attack.
Mustafizur Rahman goes a fraction full and in line with the stumps, Sikandar Raza defends this firmly towards short cover. Just 3 runs in this over!
This is on a good length as well, and outside off, Ryan Burl taps this towards point and takes another run.
Mustafizur Rahman serves this on a good length and on middle and leg. Sikandar Raza fends this towards cover-point and takes a quick single.
This one is served back of a length and outside off, Sikandar Raza gets on top of the ball and fends it back towards the bowler.
This is full and outside off, Sikandar Raza defends this towards mid off.

Mustafizur Rahman begins with a good-length delivery, outside off, Ryan Burl taps it towards cover and Sikandar Raza is already on his way to the striker's end. Ryan Burl hesitates a bit and then takes off. The fielder collects and takes a shy at the bowler's end but he misses. Ryan Burl would have been a goner if that had hit!
Tad shorter, around middle and off. Ryan Burl flicks it towards square leg and takes a run. He retains the strike!
Slower through the air, full, around middle. Sikandar Raza eases it down to long on for a single.

Mix-up there...but no harm done! Very full, around off. Sikandar Raza digs it out towards cover. He leaves his crease to sneak in a quick single. But Ryan Burl sends him back. Good call by him, had they gone for the run, they could have been in trouble.
Shorter one, around off. Sikandar Raza steps down the track and pushes it back to the bowler.
Another two! Back of a length now, outside off. Sikandar Raza pushes it towards long off for a couple of runs. 50 up for Zimbabwe!
Good running! A fuller ball, around middle and leg. Sikandar Raza makes room and sweeps it towards deep square leg. A little fumble there allows the batters to sneak in another run. Two taken!
This is back of a length and outside off, Ryan Burl gets across the stumps and rises on his toes to tap this down into the wicket to the leg side.
Hasan Mahmud bangs this in short and just outside off, Ryan Burl pulls this straight to mid-wicket.

Nice looking shot from Sikandar Raza! Hasan Mahmud goes full and wide outside off, Sikandar Raza guides this past the cover fielder towards the long deep cover boundary! Gets three runs as the fielder cuts it off.
Leg stump line once again on a good length. Ryan Burl guides this towards fine leg for a single.
WIDE! Strays down leg on a fuller length, Ryan Burl leaves this one alone and is called wide by the umpire.
This is on a good length and outside off, Ryan Burl defends this watchfully towards short cover.
Hasan Mahmud delivers this a fraction full and in line with the stumps, Ryan Burl looks to play this offside and gets and leading edge back down the pitch towards the bowler.
Another shorter ball, on the stumps. Ryan Burl punches it off the back foot towards long on. Single to end the over.
Shorter now, around off, spinning away. Ryan Burl stays in his crease and cuts it towards point. No run taken!
Tosses this one up, full, coming in with the arm. Ryan Burl looks to drive this but he misses. A loud shout for LBW, but the umpire says no. There seems to be a slight inside edge on that one.
Back of a length, around off. Sikandar Raza makes room and cuts it towards point. Single taken!
Spinning in, shorter and quicker. Sikandar Raza defends it out.
A loopy ball, spinning away, fuller in length. Ryan Burl strokes it down to long on for a single.
Hasan Mahmud ends the over well and bowls this on a good length and outside off. Sikandar Raza defends this towards cover. Testing over this one but Hasan Mahmud gets no reward.

This one was close! Bangladesh could have had another here! Hasan Mahmud serves this full outside off, Sikandar Raza goes through with the shot and gets a thick inside edge that flies mighty close to the off pole. The keeper dives and gets his left hand to it as the ball rolls over to fine leg for a couple of runs. There is a direct hit from the deep and they check for a runout. Sikandar Raza does not drag his bat in but has run well into the crease.
Hasan Mahmud serves this one short and outside off, Sikandar Raza pulls this past the square leg fielder and gets another couple of runs.
Goes full this time and angles this into the batter from outside off, Sikandar Raza clips this through mid-wicket for a couple of runs.
Swing and a miss! Hasan Mahmud is bowling good length here outside off, Sikandar Raza does not conect again as it goes through to the keeper.
Beaten! Hasan Mahmud begins with a good length delivery outside off. Sikandar Raza gets beaten on the outside edge as he looks to thump this through the offside.
Outside off, shorter in length. Sikandar Raza dabs it towards point and takes a single. Mosaddek Hossain ends with the figures of 5 for 20! A terrific spell from him.

OUT! TAKEN! Mosaddek Hossain has grabbed a five-wicket haul! An outstanding bowling performance from him! A stunning catch as well. Fuller ball, around middle. loopy one. Milton Shumba gets down on his knee and sweeps it towards deep square leg. Hasan Mahmud runs forward, puts in a dive, and takes a terrific catch. Zimbabwe have lost half their side within 7 overs! They are in deep, deep trouble. Ryan Burl comes to bat now.
Commentary.Howout: c Hasan Mahmud b Mosaddek Hossain

Commentary.Commentary: Wider now, shorter again. Sikandar Raza cuts it towards point for a run.
Straighter, flatter, quicker. Milton Shumba knocks it towards long on for a single.
Another shorter ball from 'round the wicket, spinning away from the left-hander. Milton Shumba pushes it towards long on. A midfield by the fielder there allows the batters to take two runs.
Back of a length, spinning in, around middle. Sikandar Raza knocks it down to long on off the back foot. Single taken!
This is served on a good length and angling into the batter. Milton Shumba fends this solidly towards point.
Shoriful Islam goes full and really wide outside off, Milton Shumba looks to play through the line and gets beaten on the outside edge.
This is on a good length and outside off, Milton Shumba fends this down into the pitch towards the off side.
This is on a good length and bowled on middle and leg. Sikandar Raza clips this towards square leg for a single.
Pulls his length back, and angles the ball away from the right-hander. Sikandar Raza leaves this one alone.
WIDE! Shoriful Islam serves this full and angling down leg. Sikandar Raza watches this go through to the keeper. Wide called by the umpire.

FOUR! Sikandar Raza continues batting in his way! Shoriful Islam begins with a full delivery and offers width outside off. Sikandar Raza is not going to miss out and he lifts the ball over the infield and dispatches it towards the deep cover-point boundary for a wonderful boundary! Sikandar Raza is the beacon of hope for Zimbabwe here!
Quicker in the air and outside off stump, Milton Shumba knocks this straight towards cover. That ends another successful over for Mosaddek Hossain.
Mosaddek Hossain goes full and outside off, Milton Shumba defends this back towards the bowler.
Milton Shumba is the new man in.

OUT! CAUGHT & BOWLED! Mosaddek Hossain has a four-fer! The danger man Sean Williams is out of here! Mosaddek Hossain goes 'round the wicket to the left-hander and fires this one slightly short and wide outside off, Sean Williams is down the wicket as he looks to thump this over the bowler's head! Mosaddek Hossain puts his hands up and plucks the ball from thin air! Sean Williams looks stunned but has to depart. Zimbabwe have just lost their way here!
This is angled into the pads and on a fuller length. Sikandar Raza flicks this through mid-wicket for a single.

FOUR! Streaky but a boundary nonetheless! Another quicker ball, outside off, fullish. Sikandar Raza shuffles across and tries to go over cover but the ball goes off his outside edge and towards third man for a boundary.
Mosaddek Hossain starts off with a quicker delivery full and in line with the stumps. Sikandar Raza fends this back to the bowler.
FOUR! Lovely shot! Shorter and wide of off this time. Sean Williams rocks back and slashes this past point for a boundary.

Swing and a miss! Another beauty by Mustafizur Rahman. Some swing on offer for the pacer. Good-length delivery, outside off, swinging away. Sean Williams leans forward and tries to drive this one but he gets undone by the swing.
Lovely delivery! On a length, shaping away, outside off. Sean Williams stays in his crease and tries to push this away but he gets beaten on the outside edge.
Yorker now, around off. Sikandar Raza digs it out towards cover and takes a single. He gets off the mark after facing 7 balls!
Pitches it up again, outside off. Sikandar Raza dances down the pitch and drives it towards the fielder at cover-point. Two dots to begin with!
Mustafizur Rahman begins with a fuller ball, outside off. Sikandar Raza blocks it out towards cover-point.
Mustafizur Rahman is brought into the attack.

FOUR! Sean Williams is off the mark in typical fashion! Mosaddek Hossain serves this full and in line with the stumps, Sean Williams gets on his knees and sweeps this towards deep backward square leg to get four runs on the board!
Tad shorter, around middle and leg. Sean Williams uses the depth of his crease and blocks it out.
Mosaddek Hossain serves this full outside off, Sean Williams watchful as he fends this back to the bowler.
Sean Williams walks out to bat at number 5.

OUT! CAUGHT! Mosaddek Hossain has his third! The Zimbabwe skipper has to depart! What a turnaround this has been! Mosaddek Hossain flights this full and outside off, as the ball is delivered much slower through the air. Craig Ervine goes for the reverse sweep but only manages to get a glove on it. The ball lobs up to the right of the slip fielder. Litton Das is alert and takes a fine catch to get Bangladesh right on top in this contest!
Commentary.Howout: c Litton Das b Mosaddek Hossain

Commentary.Commentary: This is full as well, and turning into the batter, Craig Ervine shuffles down the wicket and looks to work this leg side. Gets hit on the pads as he misses the delivery.

Mosaddek Hossain begins with a full delivery straying down leg side, Craig Ervine leans forward and looks to flick this leg side. Misses the line of the ball and scrapes his pads as it goes through to the keeper. Nurul Hasan collects it well and whips the bails off. Craig Ervine leaves the crease as his body weight falls forward but gets back in time as the replays confirm.
Stumping chance! There is an appeal made for stumping against Craig Ervine. The replay rolls in and it confirms that Craig Ervine was home safely.
Full and on middle. Sikandar Raza leans forward and blocks it out solidly. Good start from Mahedi Hasan, only 1 run off it!
Tosses this one up, full, and outside off. Sikandar Raza lunges to defend this but the ball goes off the outside edge towards point.
Quicker, attacking the stumps again, shorter as well. Sikandar Raza stays in his crease and blocks it out.
Back of a length, flatter and straighter. Sikandar Raza pushes it back to the bowler.
Spinning in, shorter ball, on the pads. Sikandar Raza tucks it towards square leg.

In the air...and safe! A loopy ball, spinning away, around off, extra bounce there as well. Craig Ervine presses forward and tries to block this one but the ball lobs up off the shoulder of the bat away from the first slip fielder. Single taken!
Sikandar Raza comes to the crease. Also, Mahedi Hasan will bowl from the other end.

OUT! CAUGHT! Two down in just one over! Zimbabwe are in deep trouble! Two poor deliveries have claimed two wickets. Just like the first, this was served really wide from the stumps on a fuller length. Wesley Madhevere reaches for it and hits it straight into the hands of Mahedi Hasan at cover-point. This would have been wide had he left it alone. Two wickets for Mosaddek Hossain in the first over and Bangladesh are off to a great start!
Commentary.Howout: c Mahedi Hasan b Mosaddek Hossain

Commentary.Commentary: Sharp turn as this one is pitched short and outside off, Wesley Madhevere looks to work this leg side and misses. Gets hit high on the pads.

FOUR! Zimbabwe get their first boundary! Mosaddek Hossain strays down leg once more and is a touch fuller this time. Wesley Madhevere gets on his knees and sweeps this over the fielder towards the fine leg boundary for four runs!
WIDE! Strays down leg side from a shortish length. The umpire calls this wide.
Mosaddek Hossain goes short and wide outside off, Wesley Madhevere goes back in the crease and cuts it towards backward point.
Goes full and in line with the stumps, Wesley Madhevere shuffles down the wicket and hits it to the bowler's right.
Wesley Madhevere comes to bat at number 3.

OUT! CAUGHT BEHIND! What a start for Bangladesh! They have drawn first blood on the first delivery of the innings! Mosaddek Hossain begings with a short delivery flighted outside off, Regis Chakabva looks to slash at it and reaches out wide to get to the ball. Gets a fine edge to the keeper and Nurul Hasan does not mistake taking a sharp catch! Just the way Bangladesh wanted to begin! WOW!
Commentary.Howout: c Nurul Hasan b Mosaddek Hossain

Commentary.Commentary: We are ready for action! The players are out in the middle. Regis Chakabva and Craig Ervine will open the batting for Zimbabwe. Mosaddek Hossain will begin with the ball. Let's go!

PITCH REPORT - Tino Mawoyo says the pitch is similar to the one they played the previous game on. Shows that there are cracks in the surface and says will help the fast bowlers. There is a tinge of green but is mostly dry and brown. Adds that almost 400 runs were scored in the last game and it is still good for batting. Mentions that the straight boundary is short and Bangladesh exploited it in the previous game and Zimbabwe would have seen that and would want to execute their shots straight in this game.

Nurul Hasan the captain of Bangladesh says that the wicket looks good and they want to restrict them to a decent total. Says they need to do better in the death and will look to do so in this game. Informs that Nasum Ahmed and Taskin Ahmed miss out on this game and Mehidy Hasan and Hasan Mahmud come in.

Craig Ervine, the skipper of Zimbabwe, says they will bat first. They put a decent total on the board, and the wicket looks the same so they will stick with the same plan. Mentions that they will like to give away fewer extras in this game. Informs that they are playing with the same XI!

Wellington Masakadza is down for a chat. He says that he has wroked on his batting and he is happy that it came out right in the previous game, he is happy to contribute to the team's victory. Mentions that the team stuck to their plans and the senior players like Sean Williams and Sikandar Raza helped him in his batting. Further says that there is a significant difference while opening the batting and batting down the order, while opening there is an advantage of the field restrictions and it's challenging to bat later down the order.

Bangladesh (Playing XI) - Munim Shahriar, Litton Das, Anamul Haque, Najmul Hossain Shanto, Afif Hossain, Nurul Hasan (C/WK), Mosaddek Hossain, Mustafizur Rahman, Shoriful Islam, Mahedi Hasan (In for Nasum Ahmed), Hasan Mahmud (In for Taskin Ahmed).

Zimbabwe (Unchanged Playing XI) - Regis Chakabva (WK), Craig Ervine (C), Wesley Madhevere, Sean Williams, Sikandar Raza, Ryan Burl, Milton Shumba, Luke Jongwe, Wellington Masakadza, Richard Ngarava, Tanaka Chivanga.
TOSS - Zimbabwe have won the toss the elect to BAT first!

Bangladesh’s woes with the shortest format of the game continues. This young Bangladesh side showed great fighting spirit in the first game but ended up on the wrong side of the result. Their batting unit did reasonably well but it was their bowling in the slog overs that was the issue. Even their best bowler, Mustafizur Rahman was taken to the cleaners. They will be hoping to improve in that aspect. The Bangla Tigers will have to bring their best foot forward if they want to get over the line. Can the visitors keep the series alive? We will find out soon. Stay tuned for the toss and other updates.
